itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku – Tufandag – Nohur Lake – Gabala
itinerary.description: Arrive at Baku International Airport. Meet your tour manager and proceed toward Gabala, a stunning town surrounded by the Caucasus Mountains. Continue to Nohur Lake, surrounded by lush forests, and enjoy a boat ride with scenic mountain views. Complimentary Soft Drink at Tufandag Mountain. Later, check into your Gabala hotel and relax.

itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Sheki, one of Azerbaijan's oldest towns. Visit the Palace of Sheki Khans, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its stained-glass windows. Explore the Church of Kish, believed to be the first Christian church in the Caucasus. Take a photo stop at Sheki Karvansaray, an ancient Silk Road inn. Return to Gabala in the evening.

itinerary.title: Gabala – Baku
itinerary.description: Drive back to Baku, Azerbaijan's vibrant capital city. Visit Shirvanshah Palace, a UNESCO site showcasing medieval Islamic architecture. Explore Baku city highlights – Old Town (Icherisheher), Maiden Tower, Fountain Square, National Flag Square, and TV Tower. Soft Drink during City Tour.

itinerary.title: Baku – Shahdag – Quba
itinerary.description: Drive to Shahdag, a paradise for adventure and nature lovers. Take a cable car ride and enjoy breathtaking views of the Greater Caucasus Range. Optional adventure activities (at own cost): Skiing, Paragliding, Snow Tubing, Snowmobile rides. Continue to Quba, a charming mountain town. Visit Red Village, known as one of the world's few all-Jewish settlements outside Israel. Juice at Red Village.

itinerary.title: Quba – Yanar Dag – Ateshgah – Baku
itinerary.description: Depart for Baku. En route, visit Yanar Dag (Burning Mountain), where natural gas flames burn continuously. Visit Ateshgah Fire Temple, an ancient Zoroastrian temple once visited by Mahatma Gandhi. Explore Gala Archaeological and Ethnographic Museum, a fascinating open-air museum dating back 5,000 years.

itinerary.title: Baku – Gobustan National Park – Baku
itinerary.description: Visit Gobustan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for prehistoric rock carvings and mud volcanoes. Stop for a photo at Heydar Aliyev Centre, an architectural masterpiece by Zaha Hadid. Visit the Carpet Museum, Highland Park, and the iconic Flame Towers. Evening: Walk through Nizami Street for shopping and leisure. Soft Drink at Nizami Street.

itinerary.title: Baku – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Juma Mosque in Shamakhi, one of the largest and oldest mosques in the Caucasus. Proceed to Baku International Airport for departure with cherished memories.

domestic.title: Arrival in Leh
domestic.description: You'll land at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport and head straight to your hotel to rest and acclimatize, since Leh sits at 3,500m. In the evening, take a stroll through Leh Market and catch the sunset from Shanti Stupa.

domestic.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
domestic.description: A full day around Leh covering Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, and Phyang Monastery. You'll also stop at Sangam, where the Indus and Zanskar rivers meet, before heading to Magnetic Hill and the Gurudwara Pathar Sahib.

domestic.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
domestic.description: Today's drive takes you over Khardung La, one of the highest motorable roads in the world, so keep your camera ready. Once in Nubra, you'll visit Diskit Monastery and get to try a camel ride on the Hunder sand dunes.

domestic.title: Nubra to Turtuk
domestic.description: Drive out to Turtuk, India's northernmost village, tucked away near the Line of Control. You'll get a glimpse of Baltistani culture, walk through an old mosque and monastery, and take in some genuinely stunning viewpoints along the way.

domestic.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
domestic.description: The drive to Pangong follows the Shyok River, and the lake itself doesn't disappoint — it shifts through shades of blue and green as the light changes through the day. Spend the evening right by the water before settling in for the night.

domestic.title: Pangong to Leh
domestic.description: Head back to Leh via Chang La Pass, one more high-altitude crossing to enjoy. On the way, stop at Thiksey Monastery, the largest in Ladakh, known for its striking architecture and quiet, contemplative atmosphere.

domestic.title: Departure
domestic.description: After breakfast, you'll be transferred to Leh Airport for your onward journey, carrying back more memories of the Himalayas than you probably expected.

international.title: Arrival & Acclimatization
international.description: Your guide receives you at Leh Airport and gets you settled into your hotel, since the altitude here needs a slow start. In the evening, you'll head out for a relaxed walk through Leh Market and watch the sunset from Shanti Stupa.

international.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
international.description: A guided day around Leh covering Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, and Phyang Monastery, with your guide filling in the history behind each stop. You'll also visit Sangam, Magnetic Hill, and get context on Ladakh's cultural and religious landmarks.

international.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
international.description: You'll cross Khardung La, all permits already taken care of, so there's nothing to slow you down. In Nubra, visit Diskit Monastery, ride a camel across the Hunder dunes, and settle into a local homestay for a closer look at Ladakhi daily life.

international.title: Nubra Valley Exploration
international.description: A gentler day spent around Nubra, with time to explore local villages, meet artisans, and enjoy the valley at a relaxed pace with your guide. It's a good chance to slow down and take in the surroundings before the next big drive.

international.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
international.description: Drive along the Shyok River to Pangong Lake, watching the water shift color as you get closer. Once the sun sets, stick around for a stargazing session — Pangong's night sky, with almost no light pollution, is one of the trip's real highlights.

international.title: Pangong to Leh
international.description: Return to Leh over Chang La Pass, stopping at Thiksey Monastery on the way. If timing allows, you'll also get a quiet window to sit in on a monastery prayer session, a small but memorable moment of the trip.

international.title: Departure
international.description: A relaxed breakfast before your guide takes you for any last souvenir shopping in Leh — Pashmina, apricots, local handicrafts. From there, it's a smooth transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.description: Arrive at Changi Airport, known for its stunning architecture and attractions. Transfer to your hotel, check-in, and relax after your journey. Evening: Explore the nearby area, such as Orchard Road for shopping or Clarke Quay for riverside dining and nightlife.

itinerary.title: City Tour + Singapore Flyer + Gardens by the Bay + Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
itinerary.description: Morning: Start your day with a city tour, visiting iconic attractions: Merlion Park for the perfect photo with the famous lion-fish statue, Chinatown, Little India, and Kampong Glam. Afternoon: Visit the Singapore Flyer for stunning aerial views of the city. Proceed to Gardens by the Bay: Explore the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest conservatories. Walk the OCBC Skyway for panoramic views. Stay for the Garden Rhapsody Light Show in the evening. Evening: Head to the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for breathtaking views of the illuminated city skyline.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Morning: Begin your Sentosa journey with a 2-way Cable Car Ride offering spectacular views of the island and the city. Visit Madame Tussauds Singapore and enjoy: Spirit of Singapore Boat Ride, Images of Singapore exhibition, Ultimate Film Star Experience, and Marvel 4D Experience. Afternoon: Explore Sentosa beaches or visit SkyHelix Sentosa for a thrilling ride with panoramic views. Evening: End your day with the magical Wings of Time light and water show.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Singapore + Night Safari
itinerary.description: Full-Day Activity: Spend the day at Universal Studios Singapore. Highlights include: Thrilling rides like Transformers: The Ride, Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure, and Revenge of the Mummy. Family-friendly attractions like Shrek 4D Adventure and Madagascar: A Crate Adventure. Live shows and character meet-and-greets. Dine at themed restaurants for a complete experience. Evening: End the day at the Night Safari, the world's first nocturnal zoo. Take a tram ride to see nocturnal animals in their natural habitats. Explore the walking trails like the Leopard Trail or Fishing Cat Trail.

itinerary.title: Departure to Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Morning: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Drop at Coach and transfer via coach to Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description: Morning: Half-Day City Tour (4 Hours, SIC Basis): Petronas Twin Towers: Stop for photos of the iconic twin skyscrapers. KL Tower: Visit the observation deck for panoramic views of the city. King's Palace (Istana Negara): View the official residence of the Malaysian monarch (photo stop). National Museum: Dive into Malaysia's rich history and culture. Kwai Chai Hong: Walk along this restored heritage lane with colorful murals and cultural charm. Sultan Abdul Samad Building: Marvel at the Moorish architecture of this historic landmark. Independence Square (Dataran Merdeka): Visit the historic site where Malaysia declared independence. Chocolate Boutique: Sample and purchase locally made chocolate treats. Afternoon: Return to your hotel for some rest or explore local markets like Central Market or Petaling Street for unique souvenirs. Evening: Free for leisure or enjoy the vibrant nightlife in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands Excursion
itinerary.description: Morning: Visit Batu Caves: Explore the famous limestone hill featuring a series of caves and temples, including the iconic 272-step climb to the Hindu shrine. Cable Car Ride: Take the Genting Skyway Cable Car, one of the fastest and longest cable cars in the world, to ascend to Genting Highlands. Afternoon: Explore Genting Highlands: Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park: Enjoy thrilling rides and family-friendly attractions in this outdoor theme park. Casino de Genting: Try your luck at Malaysia's only legal casino (age restrictions apply). Shopping: Browse a wide range of retail outlets at the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets. Evening: Return to Kuala Lumpur for the night.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Morning: Check out from your hotel. Depending on your flight timing, you can use your free time for last-minute shopping or a short sightseeing visit to nearby attractions like KLCC Park. Evening: Transfer to Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) for your departure flight.

itinerary.title: Visit to Shanta Durga Temple
itinerary.description: Continue to Shanta Durga Temple, a serene and picturesque temple surrounded by lush greenery and peaceful surroundings.

itinerary.title: Visit to Spice Plantation (Optional)
itinerary.description: For those interested, visit a Goan spice plantation to learn about the cultivation of spices like cardamom, nutmeg, and black pepper. You can enjoy a short guided tour and refreshing herbal drink.

itinerary.title: Sunset Cruise on Mandovi River
itinerary.description: Head to Panjim Jetty to board the Sunset Cruise on the Mandovi River. Enjoy live Goan music, folk dance performances, and panoramic views of the sunset over the Arabian Sea.

itinerary.title: Return Transfer
itinerary.description: After the cruise, relax on your ride back to the hotel.

inclusions.title: AC Transfers
